book.title: 救护车怎样争分夺秒
book.subtitle: 一条由大家让出的通道
book.question: 救护车怎样争分夺秒？

moral.zh: 救护车需要快速又安全地到达；司机、信号灯和路上主动让行的人一起帮忙。
moral.en: An ambulance needs to arrive quickly and safely. Its driver, traffic signals, and people who make room all help.

pages.zhText: 午后，安安和妈妈在公园门口听见了远远的警笛声。
pages.enText: One afternoon, An'an and Mom heard a distant siren near the park entrance.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide calm park entrance: An'an and Mom pause on the sidewalk as a distant white-and-red ambulance with soft flashing lights approaches on a separate road, no emergency scene, no fear.

pages.zhText: 安安问：“救护车为什么总要赶时间？”
pages.enText: An'an asked, “Why does an ambulance always need to hurry?”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium conversational view: An'an looks up at Mom with a thoughtful face, distant ambulance visible safely through trees, pedestrians keep to the sidewalk, no text or distress.

pages.zhText: 妈妈说：“有人需要医护人员时，早一点到达就能早一点帮忙。”
pages.enText: Mom said, “When someone needs medical care, arriving sooner lets the medical team help sooner.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Gentle explanatory scene: ambulance crew prepare a neat medical bag inside the vehicle while An'an and Mom observe from behind a park fence, no patient, injury, or readable labels.

pages.zhText: 救护车亮起警示灯，司机打开警笛，提醒前方车辆注意。
pages.enText: The ambulance turned on its warning lights and siren to alert vehicles ahead.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Safe city-road view from above and slightly behind: ambulance warning lights glow and sound is suggested by soft curved lines, nearby cars notice and slow, no written symbols, no collision.

pages.zhText: 前面的汽车听见声音，慢慢向两边移动，留出中间的空间。
pages.enText: Cars ahead heard the sound, moved aside slowly, and left space in the middle.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Clear cooperative traffic scene: two lanes of cars pull safely toward their sides while the ambulance travels through a wide open center path, all vehicles stopped or slow, no risky swerving.

pages.zhText: 安安发现，大家不是追着救护车看，而是先把路让出来。
pages.enText: An'an noticed that people did not chase the ambulance; they made room first.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Sidewalk perspective: families stay behind the curb and turn their bodies aside as the ambulance passes, An'an and Mom model giving space, no one runs into the road, no text.

pages.zhText: 到了路口，信号灯和交通指挥一起让车辆有序停下。
pages.enText: At the intersection, the signal and a traffic officer helped vehicles stop in an orderly way.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide intersection with a clear red signal for crossing traffic and a calm traffic officer gesturing safely; ambulance proceeds in its lane, pedestrians wait behind crossings, no readable signs.

pages.zhText: 救护车并不是想开多快就开多快，还要看路况、保持距离。
pages.enText: An ambulance cannot simply drive as fast as it wants; it must watch the road and keep safe distance.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Interior cab view: professional driver focused with both hands on the wheel, road ahead clear, speed shown only by motion and spacing not numbers, An'an watches from sidewalk outside, no dashboard text.

pages.zhText: 它经过窄窄的老街，司机减速转弯，警示灯仍在闪烁。
pages.enText: On a narrow old street, the driver slowed for a turn while the warning lights kept flashing.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Careful slow turn through a narrow historic street: ambulance leaves generous clearance from buildings and parked bicycles, warning lights visible, no pedestrians in road, warm daylight.

pages.zhText: 医院的大门就在前方。医护人员已经在安全位置等候。
pages.enText: The hospital entrance was just ahead. Medical staff were already waiting in a safe place.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Hopeful hospital entrance with ambulance arriving at a marked bay, two medical workers ready with a folded stretcher but no patient shown, An'an and Mom remain outside the access lane.

pages.zhText: 安安轻声说：“听到警笛，靠边停看，把通道交给专业的人。”
pages.enText: An'an said softly, “When we hear a siren, we stop, look, and leave the path to the professionals.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing teaching tableau: An'an demonstrates standing behind the curb with Mom, an ambulance lane remains clear, soft evening light, simple visual safety gesture, no text or emergency drama.

pages.zhText: 回家路上，她又想：“垃圾车每天怎样把城市照顾得干干净净？”
pages.enText: On the way home, she wondered, “How do garbage trucks help keep the city clean every day?”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Transition at dusk: An'an and Mom pass a tidy neighborhood where a friendly green garbage truck works in the distance with workers safely beside it, inviting the next story, no smell or mess exaggerated.
